products.name: HeatReel
products.tagline: Skip to the parts everyone rewatches.
products.consumerDescription: A Chrome extension that auto-generates smart highlight reels on YouTube from the crowd's replay heatmap — with a custom mini-player overlay, keyboard shortcuts (Alt+S, Alt+X), and 1-click emoji-tiered timestamp comments.

engineeringSpecs.architectureHighlight: Parses raw YouTube SVG heatmap path coordinates in real time, computing statistical intensity peaks (mean + standard deviation with a 15% fallback threshold) and syncing custom playback controls directly into the native video player lifecycle.
engineeringSpecs.metrics: Live on Chrome Web Store • Zero-backend client-side processing

products.name: PsychoScanner
products.tagline: Grade your psychometric practice test in seconds.
products.consumerDescription: A mobile OMR scanner that grades official Israeli Psychometric Entrance Exam (פסיכומטרי) answer sheets in seconds with your phone camera — supporting 19 official NITE practice exams (2020–2026) and instant 0–150 scaled scoring.

engineeringSpecs.architectureHighlight: Custom OpenCV pipeline featuring anchor detection, perspective and paper-bend flattening, adaptive illumination normalization for dim no-flash B&W printouts, and lone-mark leniency — paired with an automated NITE PDF answer-key parser (parse_nite_pdfs.py).
engineeringSpecs.metrics: 19 Official Exams Indexed • Sub-second OMR Grading Pipeline

products.name: ParaglideSlop & Game Jam Lab
products.tagline: Catch thermals with friends. Plus a stack of jam-built chaos.
products.consumerDescription: A multiplayer 3D paragliding game with custom avatar physics, alongside rapid-prototype indie Game Jam titles you can play right in your browser.

engineeringSpecs.architectureHighlight: Real-time client-server flight physics synchronization and custom Humanoid Avatar rigging seated dynamically inside a networked paraglider controller.
engineeringSpecs.metrics: Multiplayer Netcode Prototype + Playable Jam Builds

products.name: Stop For Me · עצור לי
products.tagline: Never watch your bus drive past again.
products.consumerDescription: A digital transit stop-button SDK/API designed to integrate into navigation apps (like Moovit or HopOn) to eliminate buses skipping stations.

engineeringSpecs.architectureHighlight: Designed around CBS transit validation data (780.9M validations) and passenger complaint analytics (16% station-skip rate), solving driver cabin alerting and geofenced anti-fraud request validation.
